description: Base cloud images for the local KVM VM lab (scripts/vm/lab.sh). Five x86_64 images are pinned and boot-validated: Ubuntu 24.04 (6.8), Ubuntu 22.04 (5.15), Debian 12 (6.1), Debian 13 (6.12), and Fedora 42 (6.14). The arm64 image is pinned but needs an aarch64 KVM host.

verification.description: scripts/vm/lab.sh bootstrap refuses to download an image whose sha256 is null or does not match the recorded value. Every up/run boot re-hashes the cached base image before creating an overlay.
pin_steps: Pick an immutable vendor build directory. Ubuntu cloud images are published once per build under https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/<release>/release-<YYYYMMDD>/ and never rewritten; do not pin the moving release/ or current/ paths.
Read the vendor checksum manifest next to the image (listed per entry as checksum_manifest) and copy the expected hash for the exact file name.
Download the image over HTTPS, verify it against the manifest (sha256sum -c for Ubuntu and Fedora, sha512sum -c for Debian) and, for Debian/Fedora, record sha256 of the verified file in this file.
Set status to pinned and run scripts/vm/lab.sh bootstrap --image <name>; the script re-downloads nothing and re-verifies the hash.
Boot it with scripts/vm/lab.sh up --image <name> and set boot_validated to true only after a successful SSH smoke run.
notes: Ubuntu hashes were cross-checked against the SHA256SUMS manifest of the same dated build on 2026-11-13; the ubuntu-22.04 image was downloaded, re-hashed and booted by the lab on 2026-11-14.
Debian publishes SHA-512 manifests (SHA512SUMS), Fedora publishes a PGP-signed CHECKSUM file; both are authoritative but need one translation step to the sha256 field used here.
The URLs below are the ones the lab will fetch; a mirror may be substituted by editing url and re-pinning the hash.

Debian 12 (6.1) and Debian 13 (6.12) were pinned on 2026-11-14 from immutable dated builds 20261112-2660 (bookworm) and 20261111-2659 (trixie): each qcow2 was downloaded over HTTPS, verified with sha512sum -c against the SHA512SUMS manifest of the same dated directory, and only then was its sha256 recorded here.

Debian 12 and Debian 13 were boot-validated by the kernel matrix on 2026-11-14 (stamp 2026-11-14c): both rows PASS with FileOpen paths decoded and ProcessExit events present. Evidence: docs/verification/kernel-matrix/2026-11-14c/.

Fedora 42 was pinned on 2026-11-14 after its PGP-signed CHECKSUM file was verified with gpgv against the Fedora 42 primary key fingerprint B0F4950458F69E1150C6C5EDC8AC4916105EF944, which is listed as an obsolete OpenPGP certificate on https://fedoraproject.org/security (the live fedora.gpg bundle only carries the current Fedora 43-46 keys). The qcow2 was fetched from the immutable archive.fedoraproject.org URL and its sha256 matches the PGP-verified CHECKSUM.

ubuntu-24.04.notes: Default lab image. Booted on host massive 2026-11-13 via scripts/vm/run-smoke.sh and repeatedly via scripts/vm/run-matrix.sh. Final 0.2.0 matrix row 2026-11-14g: PASS, kernel 6.8.0-147-generic, BTF sha256 8c10e7e1..., 3454 events (2701 FileOpen, 243 ProcessFork, 244 ProcessExec, 244 ProcessExit), 0 decode errors. File paths come from the kprobe/pt_regs fallback because this kernel has no bpf LSM. Evidence: docs/verification/kernel-matrix/2026-11-14g/ubuntu-24.04.json and target/vm/matrix/2026-11-14g/.

ubuntu-22.04.notes: Kernel-matrix LTS row. Booted and validated 2026-11-14 via scripts/vm/run-matrix.sh; final 0.2.0 row 2026-11-14e: PASS, Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS, kernel 5.15.0-203-generic, BTF 5290474 bytes (sha256 36e118be...), 3102 events (2382 FileOpen, 231 ProcessFork, 234 ProcessExec, 234 ProcessExit), 0 decode errors. FileOpen paths decoded through the kprobe/pt_regs fallback on a kernel whose lsm list has no bpf. Evidence: docs/verification/kernel-matrix/2026-11-14g/ubuntu-22.04.json and target/vm/matrix/2026-11-14g/.

debian-12.pin_hint: Pinned from immutable build 20261112-2660 on 2026-11-14. Debian publishes only SHA-512 manifests: to re-pin, pick a dated directory under https://cloud.debian.org/images/cloud/bookworm/ (<YYYYMMDD>-<build>), run sha512sum -c on the qcow2 entry in that build's SHA512SUMS, then record sha256 of the verified file. Never pin latest/.
debian-12.notes: Kernel-matrix Debian LTS row. Pinned from immutable build bookworm/20261112-2660 (vendor SHA512 verified; sha256 pinned) and booted 2026-11-14. Final 0.2.0 row 2026-11-14g: PASS, kernel 6.1.0-54-amd64, BTF 4355537 bytes (sha256 8f4d6b55...), 2040 events (1441 FileOpen, 192 ProcessFork, 194 ProcessExec, 192 ProcessExit), 0 decode errors, 23/23 checks. This kernel has bpf in the LSM list; the loader skips the duplicate open kprobe fallback when the LSM path is active, so the deterministic marker is decoded once per activity loop. Evidence: docs/verification/kernel-matrix/2026-11-14g/debian-12.json and target/vm/matrix/2026-11-14g/.

fedora-42.checksum_manifest_format: PGP-signed SHA256 CHECKSUM file: verify with gpgv against the Fedora 42 primary key fingerprint B0F4950458F69E1150C6C5EDC8AC4916105EF944 (listed under Obsolete OpenPGP Certificates on https://fedoraproject.org/security), then check the sha256
fedora-42.pin_hint: Pinned on 2026-11-14 from the immutable archive.fedoraproject.org release tree (Fedora 42 is past its support window; the download.fedoraproject.org release URL redirects to a mirror and may disappear). The CHECKSUM file is PGP-signed by the Fedora 42 primary key B0F4950458F69E1150C6C5EDC8AC4916105EF944; fetch that key by fingerprint from a keyserver, confirm the fingerprint against https://fedoraproject.org/security, gpg --verify the CHECKSUM, then record the sha256 of the verified qcow2. Never pin an unverified checksum.

ubuntu-24.04-arm64.notes: Kernel matrix entry for arm64: same 24.04 build as the x86_64 default. Requires an aarch64 host with KVM; the x86_64 lab host downloads only images whose arch matches, so this entry is inert here.
